eping the provider-grouped picker.
# dsh-provider-model-picker
**Provider + Model** — the composer's model control names the provider beside the model: `DeepSeek D
emo/DeepSeek-V4.1-Flash` instead of `DeepSeek-V4.1-Flash`.
**English** | 简体中文
## The ambiguity it removes

The shipped picker prints the catalog model name alone, which is ambiguous as soon
as two providers

offer a model with the same name, or as soon as the model is not
the one you think the session is on

. This plugin keeps the control exactly where
it is and adds the one fact it was missing.
[代码示例省略，未执行]
## What it contributes
| Surface | What it does |
| `conversation.input.model` | re-registered at a lower priority than the shipped picker, rendering

this plugin's trigger (`Provider/Model` + reasoning effort) and its two-level menu |
| Locale namesp

ace `dsh-provider-model-picker` | English and Simplified Chinese copy for the control |
| Composer r
ow CSS variables | honours the host's `--dsh-composer-model-text-display` / `--dsh-composer-model-ic
on-display` compact switch like the shipped occupant |

No host route, no service, no Config: the host half (`exports["."]`) exists only so
the Loader row c
an carry the browser half (`exports["./client"]`).
## The label rule
| Directory state | Trigger shows |
| Model loaded in the catalog | `Provider/Model` — the catalog provider name, or the localized **Dee

pSeek Account** for the account provider |
| Model missing from the catalog (removed, or its group f
ailed to load) | `Provider/model-id`, using the group's name when known and the raw provider id othe

rwise |
| No catalog yet | the shipped forms: `Loading models…`, then `Select model` |

The reasoning effort keeps its own caption beside the label
(`DeepSeek Demo/DeepSeek-V4.1-Pro · High

`), and the trigger's accessible name and
tooltip use the same provider-qualified string.

**A model that advertises no reasoning levels gets no caption and no Effort row** —
the control offe

rs only what the adapter publishes, exactly like the shipped
picker, because the host rejects an eff

ort its adapter never advertised. For a
`dsh-llm-pi-ai` route that capability is the model entry's `

reasoningEfforts`
(omit the field to keep the installed catalogue's own metadata):
[代码示例省略，未执行]

The level names are `off`, `minimal`, `low`, `medium`, `high`, `xhigh`, `max`.
Declaring them is a h

ost-configuration change, not a plugin one: the same levels
then appear in `/model` and in this cont

change, not a plugin one: the same levels
then appear in `/model` and in this control's Effort row.
## Screenshot

Both panels come from `tools/preview.mjs`, which renders the built bundle outside
the GUI over a fak

e catalog. On the left, the trigger names the provider and the
root pane drills into Model and Effor

t; on the right, the model pane lists every
provider group — and **DeepSeek Demo and Baidu Team both

offer
`DeepSeek-V4.1-Flash`**, which the bare model name cannot tell apart.
## How the shadow works

`conversation.input.model` is a **`single`** slot — one occupant per cell, and the
slot registry ren

ders the **lowest live `priority`**, keeping the higher entry
registered. The shipped picker (`@deep

seek-ai/dsh-client-ui-model-selection`)
registers at the default `0`; this plugin registers at `-1`.
That choice buys three things:

- **The shipped picker stays installed.** It is not removed, so nothing else that
refers to it break

s, and the `/model` command popup is untouched.
- **A crash falls back, not blanks.** The registry s

upervises entries; a component
that throws abdicates its cell and the shipped trigger renders again.

- **The data is shared.** Both the menu here and `/model` read the same
per-session directory insta

nce (`ctx.modelDirectories`), so a switch made in one
is what the other shows next.

If another occupant already holds `priority: -1`, the registration is refused —
the plugin logs and

leaves the shipped picker alone rather than breaking the
composer's own registration.

Because shadowing the seat means owning it, the plugin also ships the picker
underneath: the root Mo

del/Effort cells, provider-grouped model list, search past
four models, reasoning-effort levels, pen

ding spinner, keyboard navigation
(`↑`/`↓` walk rows, `Tab` accepts or leaves a drilled pane, `Escap

e` back/closes),
and an in-menu error strip with Retry.
[该节后续省略]
### Why it declares two services it never reads

`inject` lists `remote` and `remote.session`, which this plugin never touches
directly. They are the
re for the **callee**, not the caller.

`ctx.modelDirectories` is a cordis **service proxy**: it rebinds `this` to the
*caller's* context fo

r the duration of the call. `directoryFor()` builds a
session's directory from `this.ctx.remote.sess

ion` — but only on a **cache miss**,
i.e. the first call for a session that no other surface has war

med yet. So the
call succeeds or dies depending on *who asked first*:
| Who calls first for that session | Result |
| The shipped picker or the `/model` popup (they declare `remote.session`) | Directory built and cac

hed; a later call from anywhere is a cache hit |
| This plugin, at `priority: -1`, before the shippe
d entry renders | `cannot get property "remote.session" without inject` |

That is why the defect looked intermittent and session-shaped: any session whose
directory happened

to be warm worked, and a **session switch** — a new session,
this entry first — failed every time. T

he shipped package declares the same two
services for the same reason.

`test/support.ts` enforces the rule in its directory double, so dropping either
declaration fails th
e suite instead of the GUI.
## Requirements

- **Node.js >= 24.9** and **pnpm 11.20.0** — the version pinned through
`packageManager`, which `cor

epack enable` picks up.
- **DeepSeek Harness `>=0.2.2-rc.1 <0.2.3-0`**, the range this plugin's peer

dependencies
and its `SlotMap` typing are built against. A wrong slot id or option fails the
typech

eck.
- **The shipped model picker stays enabled**, since this control reads the
per-session director

y service it publishes.
- **`lib/` is not committed.** The published tree is TypeScript source, so b

uild
before installing the bundle.
